# Postmortem INC-2025-102: fraud-scoring degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 55 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `fraud-scoring`

## Summary
During the incident, `fraud-scoring` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4020 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `fraud-scoring` fired.
- T+13: On-call engineer found PQ-E4020 in the broker logs.
- T+27: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+55: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

# `metrics.interval_s` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `300` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | metrics |
| Unit | s |

## Notes

Changes to `metrics.interval_s` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[metrics]
interval_s = 300
```

Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3246 SCHEDULER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The internal work queue of the scheduler is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `scheduler.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E2187 PARTITIONER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `partitioner: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the partitioner is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `partitioner.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# PaderQueue 2.3 release notes

Released on 2023-03-27.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E4540 (METRICS_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E1163 (SNAPSHOTTER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the authentication module that validates client tokens starts throttling.

- New option `partitioner.log_level`: log verbosity of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Title: PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E3441 ACKTRACKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `acktracker: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the acktracker is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `acktracker.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Describes a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot describe <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|

| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |

| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot describe orders --since
```

# PaderQueue 3.1 release notes

Released on 2024-01-15.

## New features

- New option `acktracker.batch_size`: number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.

- New error code PQ-E1176 (INGRESS_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `coordinator.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

- New option `spool.log_level`: log verbosity of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period. - New error code PQ-E1019 (INGRESS_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message. - New error code PQ-E2617 (DLQ_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3221 BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `broker: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the broker is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `broker.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# PaderQueue 3.0 release notes

Released on 2023-09-18.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## Changed defaults

- **Changed default:** `partitioner.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `16777216` (previously `1048576`).

- **Changed default:** `auth.interval_s` now defaults to `300` (previously `10`).

- **Changed default:** `retention.worker_threads` now defaults to `2` (previously `1`).

- **Changed default:** `metrics.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `4194304` (previously `1048576`).

- **Changed default:** `replicator.worker_threads` now defaults to `1` (previously `2`).

- **Changed default:** `spool.compression` now defaults to `lz4` (previously `zstd`).

- **Changed default:** `quota.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `33554432` (previously `4194304`).

Title: PaderQueue 2.1 release notes
Type: changelog
Version: 2.1

exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, in bytes. - New error code PQ-E4590 (SNAPSHOTTER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message. - New option `auth.log_level`: log verbosity of the authentication module that validates client tokens.

- New option `scheduler.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

- New option `spool.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

- New option `replicator.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

Type: config
Version: 3.x

# `partitioner.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1000` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Unit | tasks |

## Notes

Changes to `partitioner.queue_capacity` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
queue_capacity = 1000
```

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

Title: PQ-E3805 DLQ_COMPONENT_DISABLED
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3805 DLQ_COMPONENT_DISABLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: component disabled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.1

## What it means
A request needed the dlq, but the dlq is switched off.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `dlq.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

Document: d0891
Title: quota.buffer_bytes (PaderQueue 2.x)
Type: config
Version: 2.x

Property | Value | |---|---| | Type | integer (bytes) | | Default | `4194304` | | Available since | 1.1 | | Component | quota | | Unit | bytes |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `quota.buffer_bytes` only if you observe problems with the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[quota]
buffer_bytes = 4194304
```

Document: d0350
Title: PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Title: PQ-E3682 REPLICATOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3682 REPLICATOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the replicator is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `replicator.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# `auth.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the authentication module that validates client tokens.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `64` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | auth |
| Unit | connections |

## Notes

Changes to `auth.max_connections` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[auth]
max_connections = 64
```

# PQ-E4426 SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `scheduler.max_retries`.

# Postmortem INC-2025-107: billing-events degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 140 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `billing-events`

## Summary
During the incident, `billing-events` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2187 repeatedly.

- T+0: Alerts for `billing-events` fired.
- T+35: On-call engineer found PQ-E2187 in the broker logs.
- T+70: The team temporarily moved traffic to the secondary cluster.
- T+140: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a failing disk on one node.

# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `checkout-service`

# `compactor.compression` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Compression codec that the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages uses for stored or transferred data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: none | lz4 | zstd |
| Default | `none` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | compactor |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `compactor.compression` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
compression = "none"
```

Title: PQ-E4572 QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E4572 QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the quota is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `quota.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

Title: Postmortem INC-2025-196
Type: incident
Version: 4.x

# Postmortem INC-2025-196: shipping-tracker degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 140 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `shipping-tracker`

## Summary
During the incident, `shipping-tracker` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4708 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `shipping-tracker` fired.
- T+35: On-call engineer found PQ-E4708 in the broker logs.
- T+70: The team restarted the affected nodes.
- T+140: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a failing disk on one node.

# `dlq.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 2.3 |
| Component | dlq |

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `dlq.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
max_retries = 8
```

# PQ-E4663 COORDINATOR_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: throttled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.1

## What it means
The coordinator is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `coordinator.threshold_percent`.

Title: PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E3642 ACKTRACKER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `acktracker: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the acktracker is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `acktracker.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E1451 INGRESS_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `ingress: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the ingress use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Set `ingress.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

# `partitioner.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | partitioner |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `partitioner.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
max_retries = 10
```

Title: PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# Postmortem INC-2025-116: search-indexer degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 140 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `search-indexer`

## Summary
During the incident, `search-indexer` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4007 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `search-indexer` fired.
- T+35: On-call engineer found PQ-E4007 in the broker logs.
- T+70: The team temporarily moved traffic to the secondary cluster.
- T+140: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

# Forum: What does spool.max_connections do?

**mqfan42:** The docs are a bit short on `spool.max_connections`. What does it actually do, and what's the default?

**k8s_kalle:** It's the setting for the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments. If I remember correctly the default is `128`, but check the docs for your version.

**mqfan42:** Great, thanks!

Title: scheduler.max_connections
Type: config
Version: 4.x

# `scheduler.max_connections`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `64` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Unit | connections |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `scheduler.max_connections` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
max_connections = 64
```

Title: PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The spool refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `spool.max_connections`.

# `partitioner.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1000` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Unit | tasks |

## Notes

Changes to `partitioner.queue_capacity` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
queue_capacity = 1000
```

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PaderQueue 2.1 release notes

Released on 2022-08-29.

## New features

- New option `auth.batch_size`: number of messages the authentication module that validates client tokens processes together in one batch.

- New option `compactor.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `quota.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.

- New error code PQ-E3108 (SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

Title: PQ-E1944 RETENTION_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E1944 RETENTION_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: work queue full`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
The internal work queue of the retention is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `retention.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E1799 RETENTION_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: throttled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The retention is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `retention.threshold_percent`.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the partitioner is full and new data is rejected.

- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `partitioner.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Type: changelog

# PaderQueue 2.3 release notes

Released on 2023-03-27.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E4540 (METRICS_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E1163 (SNAPSHOTTER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the authentication module that validates client tokens starts throttling.

- New option `partitioner.log_level`: log verbosity of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

Title: Postmortem INC-2025-152

# Postmortem INC-2025-152: user-activity degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 25 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `user-activity`

## Summary
During the incident, `user-activity` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E3859 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `user-activity` fired.
- T+6: On-call engineer found PQ-E3859 in the broker logs.
- T+12: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+25: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

# PaderQueue 2.3 release notes

Released on 2023-03-27.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E4540 (METRICS_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E1163 (SNAPSHOTTER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the authentication module that validates client tokens starts throttling.

- New option `partitioner.log_level`: log verbosity of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

# Postmortem INC-2024-120: billing-events degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 210 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `billing-events`

## Summary
During the incident, `billing-events` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2613 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `billing-events` fired.
- T+52: On-call engineer found PQ-E2613 in the broker logs.
- T+105: The team restarted the affected nodes.
- T+210: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Deletes a schedule.

## Usage
```
pq schedule delete <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--retain-days` | Number of days the result is kept before it is deleted automatically. |
| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |
| `--output` | Output format: `table`, `json` or `yaml`. Default: `table`. |
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |

## Example
```
pq schedule delete orders --retain-days
```

Title: PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# `replicator.worker_threads` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `2` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | threads |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `replicator.worker_threads` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
worker_threads = 2
```

Title: PQ-E4030 AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E4030 AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The auth refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `auth.max_connections`.

Title: PQ-E1783 AUTH_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E1783 AUTH_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The auth gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `auth.max_retries`.

# PQ-E4582 RETENTION_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `retention: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The retention refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `retention.max_connections`.

# PaderQueue 3.0 release notes

Released on 2023-09-18.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## Changed defaults

- **Changed default:** `partitioner.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `16777216` (previously `1048576`).

- **Changed default:** `auth.interval_s` now defaults to `300` (previously `10`).

- **Changed default:** `retention.worker_threads` now defaults to `2` (previously `1`).

- **Changed default:** `metrics.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `4194304` (previously `1048576`).

- **Changed default:** `replicator.worker_threads` now defaults to `1` (previously `2`).

- **Changed default:** `spool.compression` now defaults to `lz4` (previously `zstd`).

- **Changed default:** `quota.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `33554432` (previously `4194304`).

# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PQ-E2137 DLQ_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: throttled`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
The dlq is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `dlq.threshold_percent`.

Title: PQ-E2137 DLQ_THROTTLED
Type: error
Version: 4.x

# PQ-E2137 DLQ_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: throttled`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
The dlq is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `dlq.threshold_percent`.

# PQ-E3246 SCHEDULER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The internal work queue of the scheduler is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `scheduler.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Document: d0871
Title: dlq.threshold_percent (PaderQueue 3.x)
Type: config
Version: 3.x

Property | Value | |---|---| | Type | integer (percent) | | Default | `90` | | Available since | 2.2 | | Component | dlq | | Unit | % |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `dlq.threshold_percent` only if you observe problems with the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
threshold_percent = 90
```

# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.1

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the scheduler is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `scheduler.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 140 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `fraud-scoring`

During the incident, `fraud-scoring` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2547 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `fraud-scoring` fired.
- T+35: On-call engineer found PQ-E2547 in the broker logs.
- T+70: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+140: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

# PQ-E1783 AUTH_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The auth gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `auth.max_retries`.

# PQ-E2154 QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: work queue full`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the quota is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `quota.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Title: spool.log_level
Type: config
Version: 4.x

| Value | |---|---| | Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error | | Default | `warn` | | Available since | 3.1 | | Component | spool |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `spool.log_level` only if you observe problems with the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
log_level = "warn"
```

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
interval_s = 30
```

**Impact:** Delayed messages for `billing-events`

During the incident, `billing-events` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E3682 repeatedly.

- T+22: On-call engineer found PQ-E3682 in the broker logs.
- T+45: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+90: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a configuration change during a deployment.
